gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-readex-pro: Blockletter bulges through its middle like a brush pen pressed once, yet every line is drawn with pencil-light steadiness. Readex Pro stays quiet beside it.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-ruda: Readex-style openness aside, Ruda reads like wire bent into friendly shapes, with a generous x-height and wide-mouthed rounds. Blockletter is the one for sharp, precise display work, and Ruda handles the sustained reading.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-saira: Blockletter draws its heading with a strung-wire steadiness, precise and modern from the first glyph. Saira then follows with see-through s shapes and rounded letters stretching toward the top line, giving the page a lighter second voice.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-schibsted-grot: Blockletter's glyphs look cut from strips of equal width, a flat, precise look that sets it apart at once. Schibsted Grotesk keeps its big open e and a, so long reading stays inviting.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-sen: Blockletter swells through its middle like a brush belly, yet every stroke looks sketched with one unchanging pencil. Sen keeps a constant-weight line and curves that stop before turning inward, so a long passage in this sans-serif moves along crisply.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-sintony: Blockletter has no modulation in its stroke at all, just flat pencil-sketched lines with a bulging middle. And Sintony supplies a chunky midzone and smooth curves, so the plain sans below never clogs.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-sofia-sans: Blockletter's pencil-drawn letters hold one line weight and bulge only through the middle, which makes them instantly recognizable. Sofia Sans takes that restraint further, with rounded, open-sided forms and lowercase standing like cut stencil pieces under it.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-sofia-sans-sem: Blockletter swells through its middle like a brush belly while every line stays pencil-flat and unpressed. And Sofia Sans Semi Condensed reads smoothly, its lowercase nearly matching capital height, with a visible entrance into each curve.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-sono: Flat, single-weight linework with a bulging middle. And Sono follows with lowercase standing high above its capitals, wide default spacing and a half-open a, so a long passage in this plain sans breathes easily.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-stack-sans-hea: Precise, pencil-flat and modern, Blockletter bulges only through its middle. Stack Sans Headline brings wide gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp and a deep middle band, so the sans can go small without losing its clarity.
